description: Wave 1 (the core) of the investor portal at automatos.app/investors: a React app served by the site's Express server, Clerk sign-in, a short investor profile, a document library with a PDF viewer and downloads, per-page reading events, an admin area (document upload, overview, investors table and detail) and admin alert emails. Data lives in Postgres schema 'investors' (its own role); files in a private S3 bucket. Wave 2 (sections, video, document analytics, CSV, privacy text, footer link) is a later kit.

decisions.text: FILES. A story may create or change ONLY: investors/** (the React app), server/investors/** (the API, its SQL migrations and its tests), vitest.config.js (root), server.js (ADDITIVE ONLY: the portal import, its mount lines and the Clerk key in hydrateConfig; the public allow-list arrays CLEAN_URL_PAGES, HTML_ONLY_PAGES and PUBLIC_ASSETS stay byte-identical), _config.js.template (one added line), Dockerfile, .dockerignore, package.json, package-lock.json (root), .github/workflows/investors.yml (new), README.md (a 'Investor portal' section), and this kit's files under scripts/ralph/. Never: any existing .html page, any _*.js or *.css of the public site, images/, uploads/, content/, design/, .github/workflows/malware-scan.yml, .gitignore entries that un-ignore anything.

DEPENDENCIES: only these, each installed with 'npm install --save-exact --ignore-scripts <name>@<major>' (or the exact version given) and recorded in the DONE note. ROOT dependencies: the existing compression, express, nodemailer, plus @clerk/backend@3, pg@8, @aws-sdk/client-s3@3, @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner@3, zod@3, express-rate-limit@7. ROOT devDependencies: vitest@3, supertest@7, @electric-sql/pglite@0.5. investors/ dependencies: react@18, react-dom@18, react-router-dom@6, @tanstack/react-query@5, @clerk/clerk-react@5, react-pdf@9, pdfjs-dist (exactly the version react-pdf@9 depends on, 4.8.69), recharts@2, lucide-react@0, class-variance-authority@0.7, clsx@2, tailwind-merge@2 (NOT 3: v3 is Tailwind 4 only), tailwindcss-animate@1, sonner@2, zod@3, any @radix-ui/react-* package. investors/ devDependencies: vite@6, @vitejs/plugin-react@4, typescript@5, tailwindcss@3, postcss@8, autoprefixer@10, eslint@9, @eslint/js@9, typescript-eslint@8, eslint-plugin-react-hooks@5, eslint-plugin-react-refresh@0, globals, vitest@3, jsdom@26, @testing-library/react@16, @testing-library/jest-dom@6, @types/react@18, @types/react-dom@18, @types/node@22, @playwright/test@1.64.1 (exact). Anything else: RALPH_BLOCKED with the reason. The gate enforces the list and the majors.

SERVER-SIDE ENFORCEMENT. Every /api/investors route except GET /api/investors/health goes through the auth middleware; identity (clerk user id, email, investor id) comes ONLY from the verified Clerk token, never from a body, query, header other than Authorization, or cookie; admin = the token's Clerk user id is in INVESTOR_ADMIN_CLERK_IDS (comma-separated), checked on the server for every /admin route. A blocked investor gets 403 on every investor route. Unpublished documents are 404 to investors. A test enumerates the router stack and fails if any route other than /health lacks the middleware.

NEVER BREAK THE SITE. The portal is optional. Missing config (INVESTORS_DATABASE_URL, CLERK_SECRET_KEY, CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, or the S3 variables for document routes) or a failed migration puts the portal in 'disabled' with a logged reason: /api/investors/* answers 503 {error:'portal_unavailable'} and /investors serves the app, which shows 'The investor portal is temporarily unavailable' and the contact link. Every other route of automatos.app behaves exactly as on the base. Startup never throws because of the portal; migrations run in the background after app.listen and the portal answers 503 'starting' until they finish.

PUBLIC REPO. This repository is public. Never commit: env files (the secrets hook blocks *.env and *.env.* paths: document variable NAMES in README.md instead, never an .env.example), keys or tokens (sk_live_, sk_test_ with a real value, pk_live_, AKIA..., private keys), real documents, real investor names or emails, the names of the site's admins, or text from the private PRD's content plan or open questions. Test fixtures are invented (investor 'Ada Example' at 'Example Ventures', ada@example.com) and tiny (a generated one- or two-page PDF under 20 kB). No vendor branding from the reference portal (KP12).

LOCAL CHECKS ARE PURE NODE. Allowed on this machine: npm ci/install (KP2 rules), tsc, eslint, vitest (jsdom and PGlite run in-process), vite build, node --check, reading node_modules. NEVER on this machine: node server.js, vite dev, vite preview, any server or listening socket, Playwright, a browser, docker, gh workflow run, git push, opening a PR, git merge. Playwright and the docker build run in CI only (W1-05, W1-19).

TEST DATABASE. Server code talks to Postgres only through server/investors/db.js: createDb({connectionString}) over pg.Pool (max 5, idleTimeoutMillis 30000) exposing query(text, params) and tx(fn). Tests use the same interface over PGlite (@electric-sql/pglite, real Postgres in-process) via server/investors/__tests__/helpers/test-db.js, or over pg when INVESTORS_TEST_DATABASE_URL is set (CI's Postgres service). Every SQL statement is parameterized ($1..$n) and schema-qualified (investors.<table>); no string-built SQL with request data.

MIGRATIONS (deviation from the PRD's node-pg-migrate, so tests run on PGlite): numbered plain SQL files server/investors/migrations/NNN_name.sql, applied in order by server/investors/migrate.js. The runner: creates schema 'investors' only when pg_namespace lacks it (in production the schema already exists, owned by the portal's role), creates investors.schema_migrations(name text primary key, applied_at timestamptz default now()), then applies each missing file in its own transaction after SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(724001) and records it. Re-running is a no-op. A failed file rolls back and disables the portal (KP4).

CLERK. App: @clerk/clerk-react@5 <ClerkProvider publishableKey={window.AUTOMATOS_CONFIG.clerkPublishableKey}> (runtime config, hydrated by server.js from CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY; never a build-time env). API calls send 'Authorization: Bearer <await getToken()>'. Server: @clerk/backend verifyToken(token, {secretKey, authorizedParties}) with authorizedParties from INVESTORS_AUTHORIZED_PARTIES (comma-separated, default 'https://automatos.app'), behind an injectable verifier (academy server/spine/auth.js pattern) so tests use a fake. Investor email and name come from the Clerk user (createClerkClient({secretKey}).users.getUser, cached per process for 10 minutes) on first sight; later requests read the row. NO cookie auth anywhere (stricter than the PRD): the pagehide flush uses fetch(..., {keepalive: true}) with the last cached token.

E2E FAKE AUTH SEAM. investors/src/auth/ has ONE module that wraps Clerk (useAuthState, SignedInGate, AccountMenu, getToken). When import.meta.env.VITE_INVESTORS_E2E === '1' (set ONLY by the e2e build script) it swaps to a fake provider whose code contains the marker string 'INVESTORS_E2E_FAKE_AUTH'. The production build (npm run build) must not contain that marker (vite dead-code-eliminates the branch; the gate greps investors/dist). The server has no fake verifier outside tests.

S3. server/investors/s3.js (pattern: academy server/media/s3.js, lazy S3Client) with an injectable client; env INVESTOR_DOCS_BUCKET, INVESTOR_DOCS_REGION, INVESTOR_DOCS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, INVESTOR_DOCS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY. Keys: documents/<documentId>/v<version>/<safeFileName> (safeFileName: [A-Za-z0-9._-] only, max 120 chars). Presigned PUT 15 minutes with ContentType fixed; presigned GET 5 minutes with ResponseContentDisposition (inline or attachment; filename*=UTF-8 encoded). Allowed content types: application/pdf, video/mp4, text/csv, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document. Max 262144000 bytes (250 MB). Never log a presigned URL.

REFERENCE PORTAL (READ ONLY, never edit): /Users/gkavanagh/Development/Dr-Green-Cannexis/Dr-Green-Gateway. Port its UI: src/components/ui/* (only the components a story uses), components.json, src/pages/Dashboard.tsx + src/components/investor/InvestorSidebar.tsx + InvestorHero.tsx (shell), src/components/investor/sections/DataRoom.tsx (library), src/components/marketplace/CoaPdfViewer.tsx (viewer), src/components/admin/AnalyticsManager.tsx (overview, table, timeline), src/components/admin/DocumentManager.tsx (upload UI), src/lib/activityTracker.ts (heartbeat idea), src/lib/csvExport.ts. Strip ALL of: its brand names, copy, colours, fonts, domains, tiers, wallet/NFT, NDA, CRM, Supabase client and calls, Lovable code. Its data-access and permission code is never ported: every data call goes to this kit's API.

LOOK. The app looks like automatos.app: fonts Geist (sans), Instrument Serif (headings), Geist Mono (labels) from the same Google Fonts URL the site uses; colours as CSS variables mapped from the site's two moods: bone (--bg #F2EDE4, --bg-2 #ECE6DA, --fg #0F1411, --fg-2 #2C3531, --muted #6E6960, --rule-c rgba(15,20,17,0.14), --accent oklch(0.45 0.06 155), --accent-ink #F2EDE4) and pitch (--bg #0E1311, --bg-2 #161C19, --fg #EFE9DD, --fg-2 #C9C2B4, --muted #8A857C, --rule-c rgba(239,233,221,0.14), --accent oklch(0.78 0.10 95), --accent-ink #0E1311). The mood follows the site: localStorage 'automatos-mood' ('bone'|'pitch'), else prefers-color-scheme; set as data-mood on <body>; Tailwind darkMode ['class'] is NOT used: shadcn tokens read the CSS variables. Square-ish corners (radius 2px), thin rules, no gradients, no glow. Phone first: every investor page works at 390 px.

COPY. Calm and factual; no 'exclusive', no hype. Tracking notice (teaser and profile form): 'When you sign in, we record which documents you open or download and how long you spend on each page, so the team can follow up with the right information. See our Privacy Policy (/privacy). Ask privacy@automatos.app to see or delete your data.' All UI strings in investors/src/strings.ts.

CODE RULES. Immutability (new objects, never mutate inputs). Files 200-400 lines, never over 800; functions under 50 lines; React components under 150 lines; nesting under 4. zod at every API boundary (server bodies and queries; client parses responses). Errors: the server returns {error:'<code>'} with the right status, logs detail server-side, never leaks stack traces; the client shows a plain message. No console.log in committed code (console.warn/error with context in the server only). Server code is plain ESM JavaScript like server.js, with JSDoc types; the app is TypeScript strict.

EVENTS. Types: signed_in, profile_completed, document_open, document_download, page_view, section_view, video_progress. document_open and document_download are written by the SERVER when it issues a link; the client may send only page_view, section_view, video_progress and heartbeats. duration_ms capped at 600000; page between 1 and the document's page_count (when known) else 1..2000; at most 50 events per batch; body at most 64 kB; 120 requests/minute/investor on /events, 30/minute on /link, 10/minute on PUT /me (express-rate-limit keyed by investor id).

WAVE 1 SCOPE. Build only W1 stories. NOT in this wave (a later kit): team/FAQ/contact sections and their editor, the video player, per-document analytics and page drop-off charts, CSV export, the privacy-policy section, the footer link, the sitemap entry, investor update emails. The admin investor table and detail ARE in this wave. Leave hooks for wave 2 only where a story says so.

ONE PUSH, ONE PR, ONE CI RUN. Story commits end ' [skip ci]' and are never pushed by you (the runner pushes the branch as a backup). No story waits on CI and no AC says 'CI green'. When every W1 story passes, the last session runs the gate (--no-ci), then makes ONE empty signed commit without [skip ci]; the runner opens the wave's draft PR and that PR's run is the wave's CI. UI stories are verified by typecheck, lint, unit tests and, at the end, the Playwright screenshots of W1-19 in CI (no local browser: KP6).

userStories.title: S3 module: presigned PUT and GET, head and delete
userStories.description: As the portal, I need private storage for documents reached only through short-lived links (KP11).
acceptanceCriteria: server/investors/s3.js: createDocStore({config, client?}) with presignPut({key, contentType, contentLength}), presignGet({key, fileName, disposition:'inline'|'attachment'}), head(key) → {size, contentType}|null, remove(key); safeFileName(name) and documentKey(id, version, fileName) exported as pure helpers; content type and size checked against KP11 before presigning (throws a typed error the routes map to 400) → DONE — s3.js exports createDocStore (frozen {presignPut, presignGet, head, remove}), safeFileName, documentKey, checkUpload, contentDisposition, UploadRejectedError (.code, .status 400); KP11 checked before signing (ed65151)

Tests: real presigning with fake credentials (offline): PUT URL carries the content type and 900 s expiry, GET URL carries 300 s and the disposition with an RFC 5987 filename; head/remove through an injected fake client; safeFileName strips paths and odd characters and caps 120; disallowed type and oversize rejected → DONE — s3.test.js 41 tests: PUT X-Amz-Expires 900, SignedHeaders content-length;content-type;host, signature changes with type/size; GET 300 s with RFC 5987 filename*; head/remove via fake client; safeFileName; rejections (ed65151)
npm test passes → DONE — npm test: 10 files, 254 passed (ed65151)
userStories.notes: | DONE (ed65151): root dependencies @aws-sdk/client-s3 3.1157.0, @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner 3.1157.0 (exact). createDocStore({config: config.s3, client?}) throws TypeError when config.s3 is null: build it only when config.s3 is set, else the document routes answer 503 (KP4). presignPut({key, contentType, contentLength}) → {url, headers: {Content-Type}, expiresAt ISO}: the browser must PUT with exactly that Content-Type (content-type and content-length are SIGNED; S3 rejects a mismatch with 403). presignGet({key, fileName, disposition: inline|attachment}) → {url, expiresAt}; fileName is the display name (file_name column), contentDisposition makes it safe. head(key) → {size, contentType} | null (404 only; a 403 throws). remove(key) is idempotent. Every method refuses (TypeError) any key not shaped documents/<id>/v<n>/<safeFileName>: always build keys with documentKey(id, version, fileName). Map UploadRejectedError to 400 {error: err.code}; finalize re-checks with checkUpload({contentType: head.contentType, contentLength: head.size}). The client uses requestChecksumCalculation/responseChecksumValidation WHEN_REQUIRED: the default puts an empty-body CRC32 into presigned PUTs. Tests: pass a fake {send: vi.fn()} as client for head/remove; presigning needs the real lazy client (fake credentials, offline). Never log a presign result.

Answers: list {documents}, create 201 {document}, PATCH/finalize {document}, DELETE 204, upload-url {url, key, headers: {Content-Type}, expiresIn: 900} (PUT with exactly those headers), preview-link {url, expiresIn: 300}. Error codes: 404 not_found (also any non-uuid :id), 409 no_file, 409 not_uploaded, 409 stale_upload (another upload or a repeated finalize got there first: re-request upload-url), 400 content_type_not_allowed / invalid_size / file_too_large, 400 invalid {fields}, 503 storage_unavailable. description is ONE line (optionalText: no line breaks). file_name is the safe name from the key (no separate display name). pageCount is kept only for application/pdf. The first upload is v1 (version moves only on a replace); a replaced, rejected or stale upload is removed unless it is the current file; uploads never finalized stay in the bucket (OT-2 may add a lifecycle rule).
